senses.gloss: (b. h.) to rend, split.—Part. pass. שָׁסוּעַ; pl. שְׁסוּעִים, שְׁסוּעִין cloven-footed.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 537:15">Yalk. Lev. 537</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 11:26">Lev. XI, 26</cite>) <he>לש׳ מנין</he> whence do we learn that the laws of uncleanness apply to the cloven-footed animals?; <he>לשאין ש׳ מנין</he> that it applies to those not cloven-footed?; Sifra Sh’mini, ch. V, Par. 4 <he>שיסועים</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 6:5">Zeb. VI, 5</cite> <he>שי׳ ולא וכ׳</he> he rent (the sacrificial bird), but did not sever it entirely.

Tosef. ib. VII, 10 היה מְשַׁסְּעוֹ ביד וכ׳ he rent it with his hand, but not with a knife; a. e.—Part. pass. מְשׁוּסָּע cloven-footed. Sifra l. c. מפריס ומש׳, v. פָּרַס; Yalk. l. c. ומשסע (corr. acc.).
